decks.notes: This deck focuses on quickly amassing green mana symbols on the board to trigger powerful effects from cards like Nykthos, Shrine to Nyx and Boseiju, Who Endures. By utilizing fast mana creatures like Llanowar Elves and Elvish Mystic, as well as resilient threats like Badgermole Cub and Shang-Chi, Master of Kung Fu, the deck aims to overwhelm opponents with a combination of early aggression and potent late-game threats. Enduring Vitality and Quantum Riddler provide additional synergy and resilience, while Nature's Rhythm allows for explosive turns and efficient mana usage.

This UW Control deck focuses on using counterspells, removal, and card advantage to control the game and out-value the opponent. Yorion, Sky Nomad provides additional value by blinking permanents for extra value. With a mix of counterspells, removal spells like Supreme Verdict, and card draw like Teferi, Hero of Dominaria and Memory Deluge, the deck aims to outlast and outmaneuver opponents through a combination of control elements. The deck also features lands that provide additional utility, such as Hall of Storm Giants and Restless Anchorage.

Utilizing hand disruption, removal spells, and efficient creatures, this deck aims to control the board and disrupt the opponent's game plan. It focuses on gradually gaining advantage and outvaluing the opponent through card advantage and efficient removal. The deck uses a combination of disruptive spells like Thoughtseize and Fatal Push, along with powerful creatures like Sheoldred, the Apocalypse and Graveyard Trespasser to control the pace of the game. The inclusion of utility lands like Urborg, Tomb of Yawgmoth and Boseiju, Who Endures provides additional versatility and power to the deck's strategy.

The key concept of this UR Aggro deck is to quickly apply pressure on the opponent with efficient creatures like Monastery Swiftspear and Soul-Scar Mage while using cheap burn spells like Burst Lightning and Reckless Rage to control the board and finish off the opponent. The deck also includes card draw and manipulation spells like Sleight of Hand and Flow State to ensure a consistent flow of threats and answers. By combining aggressive creatures with burn spells and card advantage, this deck aims to overwhelm the opponent and secure a fast victory.

This deck focuses on using a combination of Greasefang and Parhelion II to generate a powerful offensive strategy. Utilizing cards like Esika's Chariot, Formidable Speaker, and Multiversal Passage to enhance the synergies between the two key combo pieces, players aim to overwhelm their opponent with a combination of creature tokens and powerful spells. Additionally, the deck includes a mix of disruption and removal spells like Thoughtseize, Bitter Triumph, and Collective Brutality to control the game and ensure the combo can go off smoothly.

Utilizing a combination of hand disruption, removal spells, and powerful creatures, this deck aims to control the game and outvalue the opponent. By efficiently dealing with threats and disrupting the opponent's game plan, while deploying hard-to-handle creatures like Archfiend of the Dross and Glissa Sunslayer, this deck can grind out wins in a variety of matchups. The mana base is optimized for consistency and allows for the deck to play powerful lands like Boseiju, Who Endures and Urborg, Tomb of Yawgmoth to further enhance its control capabilities.

The main focus of this deck is to maintain control of the game by disrupting the opponent's strategy with cards like Thoughtseize and Duress, while also generating value through graveyard manipulation with cards like Graveyard Trespasser and Sheoldred, the Apocalypse. The deck also utilizes removal spells like Fatal Push and Abrupt Decay to deal with threats on the board. The mana base is designed to support the deck's color requirements and includes utility lands like Boseiju, Who Endures and Castle Locthwain. Overall, the deck aims to outvalue and outpace the opponent to secure a victory.

The main focus of this UR Aggro deck is to quickly play low-cost creatures with prowess abilities such as Monastery Swiftspear and Soul-Scar Mage, then pump them up with instant spells like Burst Lightning and Reckless Rage. Utilizing cards like Academic Dispute and Flow State to draw cards and disrupt the opponent's game plan. The deck is designed to deal damage fast and efficiently while maintaining card advantage and tempo. By combining aggression with card advantage and removal, this deck aims to overwhelm the opponent before they can stabilize.

The main idea of this deck is to control the game by disrupting your opponent's hand with cards like Thoughtseize and Duress, while also removing threats with cards like Fatal Push and Abrupt Decay. The deck also utilizes powerful creatures like Graveyard Trespasser and Sheoldred, the Apocalypse to apply pressure on the opponent. The lands in the deck provide mana fixing and utility to support the control strategy. The deck aims to outvalue and outlast the opponent in a grindy game to eventually take over and win the match.

The primary focus of this deck is to control the opponent's resources and disrupt their game plan by using hand disruption spells like Thoughtseize and Duress, as well as removal spells like Abrupt Decay and Fatal Push. The deck also utilizes creatures like Graveyard Trespasser and Sentinel of the Nameless City to provide additional disruption and pressure on the opponent. The goal is to outvalue the opponent by efficiently dealing with their threats while gradually building up your own board presence to secure the win.

This Rakdos Aggro deck focuses on applying early pressure on the opponent with efficient creatures like Bloodtithe Harvester and Graveyard Trespasser, backed up by removal spells like Fatal Push and Go for the Throat. The deck also utilizes disruptive cards like Thoughtseize and Duress to disrupt the opponent's game plan. The inclusion of Liliana of the Veil and Kolaghan's Command allows for additional versatility and control over the game. With a mix of aggression and disruption, this deck aims to overwhelm the opponent and secure a quick victory.

This deck focuses on assembling a powerful combo using Lotus Field along with cards like Scapeshift and Lumra, Bellow of the Woods to generate a large amount of mana quickly. The deck also includes various lands and creatures to support the combo and ensure its success. By utilizing the unique abilities of each card in the deck, the player aims to achieve a dominant board position and overwhelm their opponent with a powerful onslaught of spells and creatures.

This deck focuses on utilizing low-cost spells and creatures to apply pressure early in the game. The key strategy is to consistently deal damage and control the board with efficient removal spells like Burst Lightning and Reckless Rage. Monastery Swiftspear and Soul-Scar Mage are key creatures that benefit from casting numerous spells in a turn. The deck is designed to be fast-paced and aggressive, prioritizing tempo and aggression over long-term value. Overall, the goal is to overwhelm the opponent with a combination of direct damage and efficient creatures.

This deck focuses on utilizing a combination of aggressive creatures and powerful spells to quickly overwhelm opponents. The key strategy is to apply early pressure with efficient creatures like Marauding Mako and Vivi Ornitier, while disrupting and removing threats with cards like Torch the Tower and Into the Flood Maw. The deck also includes card draw and flexibility with Winternight Stories and Profit's Eidetic Memory. By efficiently managing resources and maintaining a fast pace, this UR Aggro deck aims to secure victory before the opponent has a chance to stabilize.

This UW Control deck focuses on card advantage, tempo control, and board disruption to outlast opponents and secure victory. With an emphasis on countering spells, drawing cards, and deterring threats, this deck utilizes a variety of control tools to ensure dominance in a 1 vs 1 setting. The inclusion of Yorion, Sky Nomad as a companion allows for additional value and flexibility in longer games. By managing resources effectively and applying strategic pressure, this deck aims to maintain control of the game until victory is achieved.

The focal point of this UR Aggro deck is to overwhelm opponents with a combination of burn spells, card draw, and cheap creatures. By utilizing cards like Burst Lightning, Soul-Scar Mage, and Monastery Swiftspear, the deck aims to deal consistent damage quickly while maintaining card advantage through spells like Consider and Sleight of Hand. The mana base consists of a mix of Islands and Mountains along with dual lands like Steam Vents and Riverglide Pathway to ensure consistent access to the deck's spells and creatures.
